name: Befar Group Co., Ltd
summary: Befar Group Co., Ltd engages in manufacturing and sale of chemicals. The company offers products in three sectors, such as chlor-alkali chemicals, including sodium hydroxide, chlorohydrin process propylene oxide, epichlorohydrin, allyl chloride, trichloroethylene, perchloroethylene, and other chlor-alkali chemicals; C3-C4 chemicals, such as methyl tert-butyl ether (MTBE), co-oxidation process propylene oxide, propane, propylene, and other C3-C4 chemicals; and wet electronic chemicals, including electronic grade hydrofluoric acid.
